Trust: an optional explanation, secondary to listening. Rights-holder allocation is split by registered rights. The subscription split does not define record-sale fees.

SOURCE-DEFINED

Record order. Side selection. Pause and lift needle. Streaming without scrubbing. Optional purchase for offline copy and full navigation.

PROTOTYPE DESIGN CHOICES

Discovery categories, a saved shelf, focused player, support explainer, responsive desktop layout, demo checkout and original sample catalogue.

INTERACTIVE WIREFRAME

The same working flows with colour and imagery reduced, so you can review hierarchy and behaviour.
